prompt_head:
Role: Solutions Architect at Kobie
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 3-5 years of experience in solutions architecture, business requirements ana

assessments.note: About 4 years as a Systems Architect, including integration blueprints for enterprise onboarding.
Built agents and holds a PM certification, but no BRD, SCD, or Epic brief authoring is shown.
Built data validation pipelines for invoicing errors, but no COGS or delivery cost estimation is shown.
No Agile, Scrum, or waterfall methodology appears in the evidence.
Built an AI demo generator, but no RFP, RFI, proposal, or pitch work is shown.
Integration and CRM work touches partner workflows, but cross-workstream coordination is not shown.
Validation pipelines reduced errors, but scope drift and corrective action planning are not shown.
No loyalty marketing program or mechanics experience appears in the evidence.
No delivery experience in retail, financial services, or travel and hospitality is shown.
Built an operations CRM module, which is adjacent to MarTech but not campaign or CDP tooling.
No travel experience or stated willingness to travel appears in the evidence.
Candidate is based in South Florida, not St. Petersburg, and no relocation or hybrid arrangement is shown.

output.verdict_line: The candidate meets the experience requirement and has strong adjacent architecture and automation work, but lacks documented methodology, cost validation, and several preferred domains.
top_gaps: Authoring BRDs, SCDs, and Epic/Feature briefs for traceability
Validating delivery cost estimates (COGS) across workstreams
Applying Agile, Scrum, or waterfall delivery methodologies
